correctness.rationale: For n>=3,m>=n, the rank-k vertices are all permutations of (n,...,n-k+1,0,...). The candidate comes from a contact probability measure with weight 1/(m+1) at 0 and m/(m+1) uniformly on V_n, giving mean t1 and covariance [a(I-H)+bH]/m. Direct independent symbolic simplification verifies exactly the claimed all-symbolic gauge deficit factorization. Since mQ-S²>0, A_k>0, and B_k>=0 with B_k=0 only for k=n-1, all vertices are enclosed at/above T=n(n+1)-1, while V_{n-1} is outside for m<T. At m=T only V_{n-1} adds as an intermediate contact; above T all intermediate layers are strict interior. Averaging an arbitrary enclosing ellipsoid against the contact measure and applying eigenvalue AM-GM forces detR>=det(mC)=b a^(m-1), equality only at the displayed center and shape. This proves the claimed unique global MVEE without a symmetry assumption on a competitor. The lower-dimensional true optimum is not claimed.

One exact formula for all n>=3 and m>=T, including semiaxes a,b, contact counts 1+m!/(m-n)! and boundary addition m!/(m-n+1)!, and volume κ_m sqrt(b a^(m-1)).
The boundary T grows quadratically with n and is mathematically sharp for the specific two-orbit moment design, rather than a sampled or arbitrary finite cutoff.
value.rationale: The problem asks for the global minimum-volume enclosing ellipsoid of an established two-parameter polytope, rather than a contrived norm computation. The theorem obtains explicit axis lengths and Euclidean volume for infinitely many pairs (m,n), and a sharp contact-support phase boundary at m=n(n+1)-1. The critical penultimate-support orbit is singled out by an exact sign change, a structural classification missing from the source vertex/Ehrhart theory and from the earlier n=2 result. The covariance construction also offers a reusable certificate mechanism for permutation orbit polytopes. The true MVEE below threshold remains open in this report; this limitation does not remove the utility of the exact high-dimensional classification.

final_claim: For integers n>=3 and m>=n, the explicit two-eigenspace covariance ellipsoid centered at S/(m+1) times 1, transverse squared semiaxis a=m(mQ-S²)/((m+1)(m-1)) and axial squared semiaxis b=mS²/(m+1)², is the unique minimum-volume Euclidean ellipsoid of P(m,n) exactly for m>=n(n+1)-1. At strict inequality its polytope-vertex contacts are 0 and all V_n; at equality V_{n-1} also contacts. Below it the candidate fails containment, without determining the true optimum.
